title: Quadratic flip neighbor
statement: For $n\ge 2$ and $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, define a neighboring cube point as follows: if the complete quadratic bit of $x$ is $1$, return $x$. Otherwise, if some coordinate has complete quadratic derivative bit $1$, flip one such coordinate; if none does, flip coordinates $0$ and $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an element of the binary cube of dimension $n$
caveat: The meanings of the complete quadratic bit and its derivative are not included in the supplied definitions.
